name: FAANG SMA Golden/Death Cross Strategy
description: SMA crossover trend-following strategy on FAANG stocks (META, AAPL, AMZN, NFLX, GOOGL). Enters long on a golden cross (50-day SMA crosses above 200-day SMA) and exits on a death cross (50-day SMA crosses below 200-day SMA). Equal weight position sizing across all active assets.
source:
# FAANG SMA Golden/Death Cross Strategy
# Universe: META, AAPL, AMZN, NFLX, GOOGL
#
# RULES:
# - Fast SMA: 50-day | Slow SMA: 200-day
# - Entry (Golden Cross): Fast SMA crosses ABOVE Slow SMA → go long
# - Exit  (Death Cross):  Fast SMA crosses BELOW Slow SMA → close long
# - Sizing: Equal weight (1/N) across all currently held assets

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Indicators ---
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# --- Signals ---
# Continuous trend condition: bullish when fast is above slow
is_bullish = fast_sma > slow_sma
is_bearish = fast_sma < slow_sma

# Convert enter/exit conditions into a sustained held signal
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

# --- Allocation ---
# Equal weight (1/N) across assets currently in a long position
weights = equal_weight()(active_mask=held)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Allocate equal share of equity to each active position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights.weight * 100)
